questions.question: Which of these constructors is used to create an empty String object?
questions.explanation: System.String has no public parameterless constructor, so new String() does not compile. Use "" or string.Empty for an empty string.

questions.question: Which of these method of class String is used to obtain length of String object?
questions.explanation: Length is a property, not a method. Use s.Length; s.Length() does not compile.

questions.question: Choose the base class for string() method.
questions.explanation: String is an alias for the predefined "System.string" class from which most of the string() methods are derived.

questions.question: What is the value returned by the function CompareTo() if the invoking string is less than the string compared?
questions.explanation: CompareTo() function returns zero when both the strings are equal, it returns a value less than zero if the invoking string is less than the other string being compared and value greater than zero when invoking string is greater than the string compared to.
